result: The binding is stored, not positional (FP69 corrected). File links: PublishCoordinates with the link location id binds an in-place instance without deleting anything. Cloud links: refused (FP73). Moving a bound instance rewrites the linked model's site (FP72). Create Shared follows the host's active site and is refused while a bound instance exists (FP74). ACC test host reopened afterwards: version and all five links unchanged.
problem: Re-creating (v03-v06) binds every link but deletes tags, dimensions and view settings attached to the old instance; for cloud links there is no non-destructive alternative, so keeping such instances and reporting the unresolved binding is the conservative choice
